info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Events API

params.name: resource
params.description: List events with a specific resource type.

params.name: type
params.description: List events with a specific event type.

params.name: actorId
params.description: List events performed by this person, by person ID.

params.name: from
params.description: List events which occurred after a specific date and time.

params.name: to
params.description: List events that occurred before a specific date and time. If not specified, events up to the present time will be listed. Cannot be set to a future date relative to the current time.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the maximum number of events in the response. Value must be between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

params.name: serviceType
params.description: List events for a specific service type. This parameter is only applicable and mandatory when resource is set to `convergedRecordings`.

items.docs:
List events in your organization. Several query parameters are available to filter the events returned in the response.

Long result sets will be split into [pages](/docs/basics#pagination).

params.name: eventId
params.description: The unique identifier for the event.

items.docs:
Shows details for an event, by event ID.

Specify the event ID in the `eventId` parameter in the URI.
